description: A braille translator both ways — text to Grade 1 braille, and braille back to text. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

direction.description: Which way to translate. "auto" reads braille back into print and transcribes anything else; "toBraille" and "toText" force one direction.

text.description: Print text to transcribe into Grade 1 braille, or braille (the Unicode braille block, U+2800 to U+28FF) to turn back into print.

name: braille_translator
title: Braille Translator
